predictions.quote: On the current trajectory with Starship in particular, I would expect it the launch cost come down there in 2 to 3 years. Elon might say it's next week, but at least realistically a couple of years.
predictions.prediction: Launch costs will fall to the roughly $200-300/kg threshold (from about $1,000/kg today) that makes space-based data centers cheaper than terrestrial ones within 2 to 3 years.

predictions.quote: It's early days, but I think no question within 10 years most compute will be putting in space, which to give you a sense is a lot of money, like trillions, and will be bigger than any of the other space businesses today.
predictions.prediction: Within 10 years, most computing will be done in space, creating a market worth trillions of dollars that will be bigger than any other space business today.
